title: Final Grimling War / General Staginar's raid
summary: Defend the Acrylia entrance and northern fort until the high commander arrives.
overview: The final war follows General Staginar's progression and Cullin's march. Split your force between the Acrylia mines entrance and the northern fort, then clear both camps.

Cullin, Shiktan, Kufur and Fhelik must all survive. The first counterattack begins 60 to 75 seconds after both camps are clear, followed by waves every minute. Ten grimlings head to the Acrylia entrance and five to the northern camp per ordinary wave.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Assign tanks at both camps before the first wave.

roles.label: Healers
tips: Keep healing coverage on all four veterans; losing any one fails the war.

phases.label: Protect all four veterans
phases.description: Defend both positions while the chance of a high-commander wave rises.

phases.label: High commander
phases.description: The high commander can appear at the northern fort. Defeat it to end the defense and regroup the surviving veterans for the follow-up.
